title: T1485 — Data Destruction
subtitle: Watch the attack unfold step by step on a compromised file server, and see at the same time what the SOC can observe.

steps.title: OF 8 - STOLEN ADMIN LOGON
steps.caption: The attacker signs in to FILE01 with an admin account stolen by an infostealer. Nothing looks broken yet, but they now control the server that stores everyone's files.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Compare logon sources with your known admin workstations and alert on the rest.

steps.title: OF 8 - MAP THE SHARES
steps.caption: The attacker lists the shares and counts the files with dir. They are learning where the valuable folders are and how much they can destroy.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Share enumeration from an unexpected account is an early warning worth an alert.

steps.title: OF 8 - LAUNCH DELETION STORM
steps.caption: A bulk delete command sweeps the share and file tiles vanish in groups. The deleted counter climbs into the thousands within minutes.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Alert on deletion rate per process and host, not on single delete events.

detection.label: No detection

steps.title: OF 8 - OVERWRITE WITH CIPHER /W
steps.caption: The attacker runs cipher /w, which makes three overwrite passes over the freed space, so no forensics tool can recover the deleted files. The wipe bar fills pass after pass.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Secure-delete tools on servers are rare. Treat any sdelete or cipher /w run as critical.

steps.title: OF 8 - DESTROY BOOT STRUCTURES Now the attacker
steps.caption: destroys the boot area of the disk. The server goes dark and will not start again, because the boot records and partition table are gone.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Any write to a whole-disk device or a diskpart clean needs an immediate page.

steps.title: OF 8 - SOC SEES THE STORM
steps.caption: The SIEM counts thousands of delete events from one process on one host and raises a single critical incident. The storm is too big to ignore.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Correlate Sysmon 23, Security 4663, and PowerShell 4104 by host and user before the attack happens.

steps.title: OF 8 - ISOLATE AND FREEZE
steps.caption: The SOC isolates FILE01 and freezes the backup vault so nothing left in the estate can be deleted. The attacker's path back into the network is closed.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Keep an isolation and vault-lock runbook ready, and rehearse it twice a year.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: OF 8 - RESTORE AND PATCH
steps.caption: The team rebuilds the server from a golden image and restores the files from the immutable backup copy. Then they reset the stolen account and close the entry path.
steps.defender: Defender hint: One offline or immutable copy defeats data destruction. Test the restore every quarter.
